title: Midnight Lamb Braise
description: A rich and savory lamb braise with a crunchy texture, perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the lamb cubes on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb and set aside.
Add more oil if needed, then sauté the onion and garlic until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the red wine, stock, tomato paste, and herbs.
Return the lamb to the pot, cover, and transfer to the oven.
Braise the lamb at 300°F (150°C) for 2-1/2 to 3 hours, or until tender.
Let the lamb rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Skim the excess fat from the sauce and serve with the lamb.
